verdict.rationale: The OCR processor outputs tables only as markdown or HTML via `table_format`, not as typed rows. Getting database-ready JSON depends on the separate annotations feature, which extracts information into a user-supplied JSON format (`document_annotation`) and can convert charts to tables, so a table-to-schema workflow is plausible but not documented as such. Community users report that a small share of extracted forms still need human review, and one tester saw a whole page returned as a single image. missing for 10: native typed row/cell JSON output for tables, documented table-to-schema extraction with type enforcement, and hands-on evidence of clean database-loadable table output without manual cleanup.
